0022600200.text: The Boston Celtics (7-2, 2nd in the East) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-8, 15th in the East) for Boston's 10th game of the season. The Celtics sit 2nd in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, are 2-2 on the road and are riding a two-game winning streak, while the Bucks have lost five straight and are 1-4 at home. Mitchell Robinson for Boston and Gary Trent Jr. for Milwaukee are both day-to-day with illness and are listed as game-time decisions, and Boston leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 109-102 win in Boston on Nov. 4 (the Celtics won the 2025-26 series 3-1).
